name: Pedeticosaurus
sum: Pedeticosaurus is an Early Jurassic crocodylomorph from the Clarens Formation of South Africa, known from a mould of a skeleton and regarded by some authors as a doubtful name.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: NMQR 606, a mould of a mostly complete skeleton (right side: skull, ribs, dorsal vertebrae, limbs, tail and osteoderms) on two slabs, from a quarry near Rosendal, Free State.
material: The holotype; a second skeleton (BP/1/5237) referred by Gow and Kitching in 1988 was assigned to Litargosuchus in 2002.
biology: The sources consulted give no information on its biology.
author: Van Hoepen 1915
